name: Usami Saori
source:
Metis: <Umbla> (Summoning)

[url=/c31817]Keiji[/url]'s senpai. She is very strict, so strict that she spends most her time patrolling around the campus, upholding school's moral. However, she appears to be having a hard time dealing with her roommate, [url=/c31818]Nao[/url], who know of her weaknesses. 
Very hostile toward Argonauts.
